purpose: Generate isolated static previews for every Phase 3 item, category and target access class without changing existing routes, content, search, navigation, authentication, entitlements or payment.
exitCondition: Every important item has a reachable public or review preview, appears in a category and access hub, and exposes no section beyond its simulated access decision.

publicItemRules.public_core: Show the complete structural public preview and public safety checklist.
publicItemRules.public_preview: Show public metadata, safety fields, evidence boundaries and the required tier explanation.
publicItemRules.registered_private: Show public entry metadata and login requirement only.
publicItemRules.supporter_private: Show the public preview and Supporter requirement.
publicItemRules.intelligence_private: Show the public preview and Intelligence Member requirement.
publicItemRules.research_pro_private: Show the public preview and Research Pro requirement.
publicItemRules.separate_product: Show a public product landing preview without purchased files.
publicItemRules.internal_only: Do not create a public item page; create an internal review record only.
publicItemRules.restricted_sensitive: Do not create a public item page; create a restricted review record only.
